title: Study Investigating the Efficacy and Safety of a Contraceptive Patch for 13 Cycles
brief_summary: This study is examining a birth control patch for 13 cycles (1 year).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Requiring contraception
* Normal cervical smear
* Maximum age for smokers is 35
* History of regular cyclic menstrual periods

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy or lactation
* Significant skin reaction to transdermal preparations or sensitivity to surgical / medical tape
* Any disease that may worsen under hormonal treatment (cardiovascular, liver, metabolic)
* Use of other contraceptive methods than study medication
